name: cortico-world-fun
description: 从0开始的肥鱼大冒险 —— 给 Coopanion 桌宠二十处真能去逛的地方：游乐场、海洋馆、庙会、漫展、电影院、动物园、公园、电玩城、KTV、博物馆、猫咖、爬山、咖啡店、奶茶店、餐厅、图书馆、夜市、澡堂、旧货市场、江边。进门、逛摊位、买纪念品、拍张照、吃喝点什么，回家记一笔。能和「鱼的每一天」「生图工作室」联动，但都不依赖。

zh.description:
给 Coo 二十处能真去逛的地方：游乐场、海洋馆、庙会、漫展、电影院、动物园、公园、电玩城、KTV、博物馆、猫咖、爬山、咖啡店、奶茶店、餐厅、图书馆、夜市、澡堂、旧货市场、江边。她说一声进门，一处一处地逛项目、抽个签、买点纪念品、拍张照、喝杯奶茶，回家时回执把这一趟收成一句话，接着去记进自己的日程。

能和别的插件联动，但都不依赖：装了「鱼的每一天」时，日程叫醒里会顺手提到这块、回家回执也会提醒她去 feast_life_play 记一笔；咖啡店、奶茶店、餐厅、夜市吃的东西去「鱼的每一天」点一道，那里才有九维口感、香气和余韵——没装就只知道喝了杯奶茶，不编味道。装了「生图工作室」时，回家回执会告诉她发图该填哪个 scene、哪身衣服；素材库里没有的那几处会明说不用填，绝不替她编一个不存在的场景名。这些插件一个都不装也照样能逛，库挪走了也不影响。

0.3.3 提供默认收起的故事编辑器、本机加密的可选主持接口与可选图片来源；六个面板保留故事创作、隔离试玩、地点册、行程回忆与探索档案。随版本内置《折潮港的第七封回信·简编版》《雨停前的小小清单》《桥底下的回声》《被换掉的说明牌》四篇故事及折潮港、折角巷两个地点；旧五篇与样章场所已移除，升级先备份且只移除与内置内容完全一致的历史副本，用户其他创作、已出发行程和回忆保留。自填地点无剧情也可正常游玩。

0.4.3 把六个面板统一成「旅行手账」：纸色版式与统一圆角、地点册按四组编辑并带固定保存栏、纪念册多一栏心愿、纪念品架排成展示柜、故事工坊按作品库浏览。不改存储模型，也不动已有行程与回忆。

0.4.4 新增第七个面板「家」：一张 2D 房间、十个活动、可换背景与每个姿势的图；房间状态单独存在 fun/home/，不写行程、不读别的插件，没图也能用。

en.displayName: Adventures of Fat Fish from Scratch
en.description:
Twenty places she can actually go: an amusement park, an aquarium, a temple fair, a fan convention, a cinema, a zoo, a park, an arcade, a karaoke box, a museum, a cat cafe, a hike, a coffee shop, a bubble-tea stand, a restaurant, a library, a night market, a bathhouse, a flea market and a riverside walk. She walks in, wanders one spot at a time, buys a souvenir, takes a photo, has something to eat or drink, and the closing receipt sums the trip up in one line she can log into her own day.

Works alongside other plugins but depends on none. With Fish Every Day installed, the own-time menu points at this world and the closing receipt reminds her to log the trip with feast_life_play; food and drink at the coffee shop, tea stand and restaurant are meant to be ordered from Fish Every Day, where the nine-axis flavour profile and aroma actually live — without it she only knows she had a bubble tea, and she is told not to invent how it tasted. With the image studio installed, the receipt names the scene and outfit to draw; venues the library does not have are marked as such instead of inventing a name. None of them are required, and it still works if the image library is gone.

Version 0.3.3 adds a collapsed story editor, locally encrypted optional DM credentials and optional image sources. Six panels retain authoring, isolated playtests, places, trip memories and exploration. Four approved stories ship with the plugin (The Seventh Unsent Reply of Foldtide Harbour, A Small List Before the Rain Stops, Echo Under the Bridge, The Swapped Plaque), together with their harbour and alley places; all five old presets and the sample venue are gone. Upgrades back up originals and remove only byte-identical copies of the newly built-in content. Other user creations, active trips and memories remain. Custom places work without stories.

Version 0.4.3 unifies the six panels into one travel-journal look: paper tones and a single radius scale, a grouped place editor with a sticky save bar, a wish sidebar in the trip book, a display-cabinet shelf grid, and a library view in the story workshop. No storage changes; existing trips and memories are untouched.

Version 0.4.4 adds a seventh panel, Home: a 2D room with ten activities, replaceable background and pose art. Room state lives in fun/home/ and never writes trips or reads other plugins; it works with no art at all.
